title: Structural Diversity of F-Element Monophthalocyanine Complexes

synthesis.procedure: Under N2, DMSO (10 mL) was added to PcH2 (1.00 g, 1.95 mmol) in a three-neck flask fitted with a reflux condenser and a solid-addition funnel containing DyCl3 (1.61 g, 5.99 mmol). nBuLi (2.7 mL of a 1.6 M THF solution, 4.29 mmol) was added. The mixture was heated to 189 °C, DyCl3 was added, and heating was continued for 10 min. The flask was removed from the oil bath, opened to air, and cooled briefly. Water (10 mL) was added and the mixture was hot-filtered. The dark-green powder was rinsed with water (2 × 20 mL) and dried in vacuo for 2 h, giving PcDyCl(DMSO)·(H2O)3. Recrystallization from THF/hexanes gave X-ray-quality crystals of PcDyCl(DMSO).

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT is close to the value expected for Dy(III). The χMT versus T data show no significant Dy–Dy coupling, and AC susceptibility shows no significant χ″, so the dimer is not an SMM. The bulk material has a typical phthalocyanine UV/Vis spectrum.

measurements.conditions: room temperature; powder in eicosane, DC susceptibility 1.8–300 K at 1 T

synthesis.procedure: Under N2, DMSO (10 mL) was added to PcH2 (1.00 g, 1.95 mmol) with ErCl3 (1.64 g, 5.99 mmol) in a solid-addition funnel. nBuLi (2.7 mL of a 1.6 M THF solution, 4.29 mmol) was added. The mixture was heated to 189 °C, ErCl3 was added, and heating was continued for 10 min. After brief cooling in air, water (10 mL) was added and the mixture was hot-filtered. The dark-green powder was rinsed with water (2 × 20 mL) and dried in vacuo for 2 h, giving PcErCl(DMSO)·(H2O)3. Recrystallization from THF/hexanes gave X-ray-quality crystals of PcErCl(THF).

synthesis.procedure: PcDyCl·DMSO (100 mg, 0.127 mmol) was dissolved in DMF (10 mL) and passed through a silica-gel column with wet methanol. The solvent was removed in vacuo and the residue was extracted with methanol (5 mL) to give PcDyOH(H2O)3. Alternatively, PcDyCl(DMSO) (50 mg, 0.064 mmol) was stirred in methanol (10 mL) for 20 h; the solvent was removed and the residue extracted with DME (5 mL). Recrystallization from DME or methanol gave X-ray-quality crystals.

synthesis.procedure: The main text reports a low-yield rational preparation from PcDyOH(H2O)3 and 1/3 equivalent of LiCp*, after an accidental isolation during attempted ring reduction of PcDyCl(DMSO) with two equivalents of LiCp* in the presence of water. In the SI, solid LiCp* (5 mg, 0.035 mmol) was added slowly to PcDyOH(H2O)3 (60 mg, 0.080 mmol) in THF (15 mL). After stirring for 20 h the solvent was removed, the residue was extracted with toluene (10 mL)/hexanes (1 mL), and the extract was filtered through Celite. Recrystallization from toluene/hexanes gave the crystalline cluster.

properties.summary: No magnetic data are reported for the trimer. It shows a typical phthalocyanine UV/Vis spectrum, and cyclic voltammetry shows irreversible ring reductions and a reversible ring oxidation, which are not recorded here as optical or magnetic measurements.
